5. For the simple stream performance measurement (U6), use Micrometer for metrics collection to ensure compatibility with common monitoring systems and standardize metric formats.
6. For the static gh_pages site (U7), use Jekyll as the static site generator hosted on GitHub Pages to eliminate the need for separate hosting infrastructure and enable easy content updates via Git.
7. For the Lattice/Diego POC (U8), use Java's built-in ServiceLoader mechanism for the pluggable SPI design to minimize external dependencies and align with standard Java platform patterns.

Use GitHub Actions with self-hosted Windows runners for the Windows CI build pipeline to maintain full control over the build environment and avoid reliance on third-party CI services.
Use Micrometer for metrics collection in the performance test harness to ensure compatibility with common monitoring systems and standardize metric formats.
Use Jekyll hosted on GitHub Pages for the static gh_pages site to eliminate separate hosting infrastructure costs and enable easy content updates via Git.
Use Java's built-in ServiceLoader mechanism for the Lattice/Diego pluggable SPI POC to minimize external dependencies and align with standard Java platform design patterns.
assumptions: The development team has existing access to an AWS account with permissions to launch EC2 instances, create AMIs, and configure network security groups.
The Spring XD runtime codebase, including existing Kafka source and sink module implementations, is available in a version-controlled repository with all required dependencies already configured.
Performance test requirements (target throughput, message size, test duration, success criteria) are defined in a separate requirements document accessible to the development team.
Publicly available documentation for Lattice and Diego platforms is sufficient for the POC, with no need for access to private platform source code or custom platform modifications.
All third-party software used in the increment is already approved for use under the project's open-source license policies.

The assigned developer has existing proficiency in Java 17, Spring Framework, Spring Cloud Stream, Apache Kafka, AWS EC2, GitHub Actions, and Java SPI patterns, so no additional onboarding or training time is required.
The static gh_pages site will be hosted under the project's existing GitHub organization, with no need for custom domain configuration or separate hosting infrastructure.

activities.activity_name: Provision EC2 AMI for Kafka Performance Tests
activities.activity_description: Launch a base Amazon Linux 2 EC2 instance, install Java 17, Apache Kafka 3.x, system monitoring utilities (iostat, vmstat, collectd), configure network security groups to allow required Kafka traffic, and create a reusable AMI for performance test execution.

Implement a Spring Cloud Stream Kafka source module with configurable message generation rate, payload size, and payload format (text/binary), add unit tests for core functionality, and write usage documentation for the module.

Implement a Spring Cloud Stream Kafka sink module that consumes messages from Kafka, tracks received throughput and message count via Micrometer, supports configurable consumer group and offset settings, add unit tests, and write usage documentation.

Set up a self-hosted Windows runner in GitHub Actions, configure build workflow to trigger on pull requests and nightly scheduled runs, preinstall JDK 17, Maven, and required test dependencies on the runner, add build failure notifications to the team communication channel.

Modify the existing Kafka source module to use manual offset commit mode, add input validation for user-provided offset ranges, implement configurable offset reset policies (earliest/latest), add integration tests for offset management functionality, and update module documentation.

activities.activity_name: Implement Simple Stream Performance Test Harness
activities.activity_description: Create a test harness that deploys the source and sink modules, runs configurable duration performance tests, collects end-to-end throughput and latency metrics, exports results to CSV for analysis, and add a local execution script for the test.

activities.activity_name: Build and Deploy Static gh_pages Site
activities.activity_description: Set up a Jekyll-based static site hosted on GitHub Pages, structure content into sections for samples, tutorials, performance benchmarks, and reference architectures, add initial collateral content, and configure the site for public access.

Research Lattice/Diego platform SPI requirements, design a Java ServiceLoader-based pluggable SPI for the XD runtime, implement a sample Lattice/Diego integration module, run the POC to validate feasibility, document scope, risks, and design tradeoffs in an RFC, and present findings to stakeholders.

Integrate the source, sink, and offset management fixes in a test environment, run end-to-end tests to validate message flow, offset handling, and throughput measurement functionality, resolve any integration issues, and update test documentation.
